answer_text: Design verification MC - requires ngspice simulation to determine actual failing specs

choices.A: Power consumption exceeds the maximum limit
choices.C: DC gain is below the minimum requirement
choices.D: Quality factor Q is too low
choices.F: Passband gain does not meet the target
choices.G: Center frequency deviates from target by >10%
choices.H: Phase margin is insufficient for stability
choices.J: Cutoff frequency is outside the tolerance range

note: Design MC questions require runtime simulation - correct answer is determined dynamically
